# Contra

> > Contra is a commission-free professional network connecting independent creators and tech professionals with freelance opportunities, expert verification, and compliant global payment solutions.

Contra is a modern freelance platform that eliminates traditional commission fees while providing project management, contract signing, and payment processing tools. The platform serves both independent professionals seeking work and companies looking to hire flexible talent, with specialized expert networks for creator tools like Framer, Spline, and Rive.

## Key Topics

- Commission-free payments
- Global payments
- Contract management
- Tax compliance
- Freelance platform
- Expert networks
- Project management
- Talent discovery
- Payment processing
- Invoice management
- Contractor hiring
- Remote work
- Framer
- Spline
- Rive

- [Get discovered as a freelancer | Contra](https://contra.com/features/get-discovered): Get discovered by clients on Contra's freelancer discovery platform and expert network.
- [Manage freelance projects all in one place | Contra](https://contra.com/features/manage-freelance-projects): Consolidate freelance workflow with project management, invoicing, and commission-free payments.
- [Contract management for freelancers | Contra](https://contra.com/features/sign-freelance-contracts): Sign and manage compliant freelance contracts with commission-free global payments.
- [Get paid for freelancing commission-free | Contra](https://contra.com/commission-free): Accept global payments commission-free via PayPal, USDC, VISA on Contra platform.
- [Contra Pro Membership](https://contra.com/pro): Upgrade to Contra Pro membership for enhanced visibility and professional tools.

## Compliance & Payments
